annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC); Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten common guiding principles: human-centric, safety, fairness, privacy, security, transparency, accountability, education/literacy, fair competition, innovation
Roles divided among AI developers, AI providers and AI business users, each with tailored duties
Voluntary, risk-based approach proportionate to risk level and probability
Additional commitments for advanced AI systems drawn from the Hiroshima Process code of conduct
Living document updated through multistakeholder agile governance
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Japan's MIC/METI voluntary AI Guidelines for Business (v1.1, April 2025) set ten common guiding principles and role-specific duties for AI developers, providers and business users, plus extra provisions for advanced AI from the Hiroshima Process. It takes a risk-based, innovation-friendly, agile-governance approach. It has no robot-specific content.
annotation.venue: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications / Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry
